frame: Current robot origin; x front, y left; normalized XY = meters / 0.1; hx,hy = cos,sin(local yaw)
fixed_inputs: Official current image repeated six times; official goal image placeholder; black maps; all-one pixel masks; language token xxxx; same checkpoint/runtime

criteria.FRONT: Selected metric x > 0 and abs(atan2(selected_y, selected_x)) <= pi/4 (no gross turn)
criteria.LEFT: Selected metric x > 0, selected y > 0, mean trajectory y > 0, final angular velocity > 0
criteria.RIGHT: Selected metric x > 0, selected y < 0, mean trajectory y < 0, final angular velocity < 0
criteria.masking: Pose FRONT: changing only goal image to black; max absolute native difference <= 1e-6
criteria.memory: No OOM, finite outputs, last-10 warm allocated/reserved span <= 16 MiB after warmup
criteria.cadence: FEASIBLE if pipeline p95 <= 1/3 s and fraction exceeding <= 0.05; MARGINAL if median <= 1/3 s otherwise INFEASIBLE
